title: Quant Is Building the Layer the Banks Let In
description:
So what is Quant? People in my community and in my live streams have been telling me to buy $QNT for quite some time. There are so many tokens, I can't buy everything, so I did a deep dive and broke it all down.

Here's the short version. Quant is a London company founded in 2015 by a guy named Gilbert Verdian, and what they sell is not a new blockchain. It's a software layer that sits on top of the systems a bank already runs, and it connects them to the blockchains and digital money networks out there. Their customers are banks, financial institutions and capital markets.

I tell it as a story: think of every bank as an island, and the money on one island can't walk over to the next one. Then I go through who is actually using this and what the token actually does. And I look at $QNT the way the pros do, as ratios: against the total crypto market, against its peers and priced in $BTC. I close with my read. What's yours?
